title: Inside Lucky Cookies
subtitle: A crisp outer shell with a tattered note inside. Everyone likes to read their fortune.

trails.title: Organize your notes and draw conclusions from your clues.

items.text: A Nightmare at Green Lake
The ghost bride's flesh and wedding dress smash to the ground, emitting a beastly stench and turning into a pile of black fur.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: There's a note hidden inside, just like the one found in the butcher's corpse.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Someone is passing messages to us through these notes.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: If we defeat more monsters, we will get a clearer picture of what's happened at Green Lake Campsite.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: This is the all-time favorite trick of the "plotter."

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: He takes the whole situation under control, playfully teases the innocent participants like us, through which he gains a special sense of fulfillment.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: But we have our means to cope with it.
Horropedia raises the note with his left hand and the shiny ring with his right hand and smiles.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: The ring brought us a putrefied ghost bride.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Then we got the book, the pillbox, the weird samples. Every item from the attic comes from a monster we just confronted.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: "Touching the forbidden, and the misfortune will befall you." We can find stories of this kind in many civilizations, but what if we use it to fight back ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Not to wait for the monsters, but "summon" them to us.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Exactly. If you want, we can select which ones to summon first.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: If you carefully look into each of these, you'll find that these items have a lot to tell us.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: If we plan their arrivals and predict their weaknesses in advance, victory will absolutely be ours.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: A risky strategy, but could be equally beneficial.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: However we decide to do this, it's always better to take action before our enemy does.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Horropedia, how likely is it for you to get their weaknesses right?

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Almost 100%.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: If one Horropedia isn't enough, we have one more creative "Ms. Horropedia" here as backup.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Ugh ...! You can't be talking about me?

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Of course, you. You are erudite and experienced in horror movies. Relax, you deserve the title of Horropedia.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Does he always vex people like this? Or, is he just being annoying here?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Mr. Horropedia is not a bad person. He's just a bit unconventional.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: There's no doubt. This is the craziest carnival ever!

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: The delirious fog, the attic filled with curses, the rainy night, and the countless monsters ...

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: I praise you! My beloved cabin in the woods!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Good, this should be the last note.

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: Vertin, these are all the notes we can find in the backyard!

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: I just checked on Jennifer and Sonetto. They are still looking for more, but this shouldn't take them much longer.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Thank you for your update.

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: Except that ...

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: Vertin, can I ask you a question?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Sure, please.

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: Do you have any wishes?

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: Big ones, small ones, hilarious ones, or sincere ones, any wishes.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Me?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Hmm. I think, I currently don't have any wishes.

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: Not even for the most trivial things? Like candies, a good rest, or a soft bed?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: My life is good enough without them.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: You look pretty shocked. Have they all told you what they want?

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: Yes.

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: Jennifer wants a soft bed and a hot tub. Mr. Horropedia wants a cup of coffee or gum.

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: Ms. Tooth Fairy wants a collection of critter teeth, and Sonetto ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Yeah?

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: She wants a toffee. She said she wants to taste it properly this time, for she has never really paid attention to the flavor.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Once we get out of here, their wishes will soon come true.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: How about you, Anne? What do you wish to get?

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: Me?
Anne seems to be shy. She scrunches up her chest and scratches her nose lightly.

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: It is a secret. I can't tell you now.

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: But I will get you some presents. I don't have many friends, and I really like you.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Great! Timekeeper and Anne, you are here!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: We have found every piece of information we can. We can start cross-examining them any minute.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I get it. Let's go back.

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: Have you noticed?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Noticed what?
Anne reaches out a dry palm and points to the moon.

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: That … the rain has stopped.
